remnux.packages.7zip.reason: The REMnux PPA builds 7zz for amd64 only, so arm64 adds 7-Zip's own arm64 build of 7zz. Same commands.

remnux.packages.aeskeyfind.reason: Ubuntu builds aeskeyfind for amd64 only, so arm64 installs the REMnux PPA's rebuild, which adds the PPA repository states.

remnux.packages.inspircd.reason: InspIRCd publishes amd64 packages only, so arm64 installs Ubuntu's older inspircd package instead of the upstream .deb.

remnux.packages.powershell.reason: Microsoft's apt repository has no arm64 PowerShell, so arm64 installs the release tarball. Same pwsh command.

remnux.packages.radare2.reason: r2ghidra publishes an amd64 .deb but only a zip bundle for arm64, so arm64 extracts the bundle and links the plugin into radare2's plugin directory. Same pdg command.

remnux.python3-packages.pe-tree.reason: PyQt5 has no arm64 wheel, so arm64 installs Ubuntu's python3-pyqt5 and pe_tree's other dependencies explicitly.

remnux.python3-packages.peepdf-3.reason: STPyV8 has no arm64 build, so arm64 installs peepdf-3 without it. The Arm64 note says JavaScript emulation is unavailable.

remnux.python3-packages.peframe.reason: The PyPI readline package can't build on arm64, so arm64 installs peframe-ds's other dependencies first, then peframe-ds without dependencies. Python's own readline module covers Linux.

remnux.python3-packages.qiling.reason: keystone-engine has no arm64 wheel, so arm64 adds cmake and a compiler and builds keystone-engine without build isolation.

remnux.python3-packages.stpyv8.reason: Macro library that peepdf-3 and thug call. STPyV8 publishes x86_64 wheels only.

remnux.scripts.r2decomp.reason: Inherited from radare2: arm64 installs r2ghidra from upstream's zip bundle instead of the .deb.

remnux.tools.cutter.reason: Cutter publishes no Linux arm64 AppImage, so arm64 installs the REMnux PPA package instead of the AppImage.

remnux.tools.goresym.reason: GoReSym publishes x86-64 Linux builds only, so arm64 installs the REMnux PPA package instead of the release zip.

remnux.tools.polarproxy.reason: arm64 extracts PolarProxy's arm64 build to its own directory, so the state IDs differ. Same command.

remnux.tools.redress.reason: redress publishes amd64 builds only, so arm64 installs the REMnux PPA package. The r2ghidra differences are inherited from radare2.
